source: EduRABSA_ASQE (HuggingFace datasets load_from_disk), mapped via _d2_e2_map_edurabsa.py to external_data/EduRABSA_mapped/edurabsa_{train,test,all}_mapped.jsonl
note: The source-label to schema-aspect dict is recovered from _d2_e2_map_edurabsa.py (CATEGORY_TO_ASPECT). Per-row aggregation: if all mentions of an aspect within a row agree on polarity, that polarity is kept; mixed-polarity aspects are dropped for that row. The 2 schema aspects with no EduRABSA category (assessment_design, grading_transparency) are not covered, so 7 of the 20 schema aspects overlap. Support/polarity counts in the accompanying table are computed over the combined (train+test) mapped set of 5584 reviews; one review may carry multiple aspects.
